title: GTA 6 Costs You $79.99. GTA 5 Cost More
caption:
GTA 6 Standard is $79.99. GTA 5 launched at $59.99 in 2013, which is about $86 today after inflation (our calculation with US BLS CPI data), so GTA 6 is roughly $6.50 cheaper in real terms. Day 3 of our GTA 6 countdown.
Does $80 feel cheap or expensive to you?

Sources: Rockstar Games, US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Technobezz
